q: Can a factory count floating solar on its own pond as clean power?
title: Floating solar on a factory pond
short: Yes. Solar panels on your own reservoir or effluent pond work like rooftop solar: units used on site cut grid purchases, so Scope 2 falls. Keep the generation log. If any units are exported, follow the discom's net or gross metering terms.

ul: Approval or metering agreement with the discom.

p: Shading the pond can cut evaporation. Report that as a water benefit, not a carbon one.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
